content_sections.body: Read this model: 'I have considered discussing alternatives, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.' content_sections.body: Prepare a one-minute response about discussing alternatives. Organize it into thought groups, stress the words that carry your main point, and finish with a concise conclusion rather than a list of isolated sentences.
